transcript.content: Hello, welcome. What brings you in to see me today?

Well, I came in because my mind keeps going blank at the worst times. I'll just be at work—I'm a flagger—and I will look at the road-closure forms or my stop-slow paddle, and suddenly I just cannot remember the steps. It's things I have done for years, but my brain just stops, and the thoughts aren't there.
About how long does one of these blank spells typically last?

I'm not really sure, to be honest. It's hard to tell time when it happens. It feels like maybe a few minutes, but I haven't really timed it. I just know it's long enough to make me panic a little because I should know what I'm doing.

{"intent": "Assess for post-ictal symptoms such as fatigue or confusion to evaluate for seizure activity", "question": "How do you feel physically and mentally right after one of these episodes ends?"

I don't really feel any different, honestly. I'm just kind of frustrated and a little anxious because I couldn't remember what I was doing. But physically, I feel fine. I'm not tired or dizzy or anything like that. I just go back to trying to finish whatever I was working on.
About when did you first start noticing these blank spells happening?
I'm not exactly sure when it first started. It feels like it's been happening for a while now, but I couldn't give you a specific date or anything. It just sort of crept up on me, I guess.
Outside of these moments at work, do you find yourself frequently worrying about different everyday things?

Not really, no. I mean, I get frustrated about those blank spells, but... I don't really sit around worrying about regular everyday stuff. It's not like I'm constantly anxious about bills or errands or things like that. I just don't really have that kind of worry going on.
Over the past several weeks or months, have you been feeling persistently down, sad, or depressed?

Yes. It's been pretty constant for a while now. Most mornings, I wake up and there's just this... heavy, hollow sadness right in my chest. It honestly feels like the day is already ruined before I even put my feet on the floor.
Have you ever experienced a period of feeling this down and depressed in the past, before this current time?
No, I don't think so. I mean, I've had bad days before, like anyone, but... nothing like this. This is the first time it's been this bad and just... lasted this long.
Have you lost interest or pleasure in things that you normally enjoy doing?

No, I haven't really noticed that. I mean... I still like the things I normally enjoy. I might feel heavy and sad, like I said, but I haven't lost interest in my hobbies or anything. I still want to do them.
Have you been feeling unusually tired or lacking energy to get through the day?

No, my energy levels seem pretty normal, actually. I don't feel unusually tired or anything. I can still get through my shift at work and do what I need to do around the house without feeling completely drained.

{"intent": "Screen for an underlying medical condition or history of head trauma to evaluate for an organic etiology", "question": "Have you had any head injuries, concussions, or significant medical illnesses?"
No, nothing like that. I haven't been in any accidents or hit my head, and my health has always been pretty good. I don't have any major medical problems.
How has your sleep been lately?
My sleep has been fine, honestly. Um... I haven't really noticed any changes there. I usually fall asleep okay and sleep through the night, so... yeah, no real issues with that.
Have you noticed any changes in your appetite or weight recently?

Yes, actually. Food has just... stopped meaning much to me lately. I end up skipping meals without even really noticing. I only realized it because my flagger pants for work are getting pretty loose, and my family has started asking why I look so drawn.
Have you been struggling with feelings of worthlessness or feeling excessively guilty about things lately?

Yes, a lot. I just keep replaying every little thing I failed to do... for my friend, for the choir, and for my own family. I just feel like a completely useless person right now. Honestly, I feel like I deserve whatever punishment is coming my way for all of it.
Have you had any thoughts that life isn't worth living, or thoughts of harming yourself or wanting to die?

Yes. Um... I just don't have the energy to fight the thought anymore. I keep thinking that it might be better if I just didn't wake up. I've actually started saying it out loud recently, which... I know it really scares my family when I do. But it's just the truth of how I feel right now.
